reports.headline: Late-Night Activity Beneath Abandoned Storehouse
reports.body: Residents have complained about music, shouting and bells beneath an abandoned storehouse {dir} of the village {dist} after midnight. Several unfamiliar travelers have been seen entering carrying coins but leaving empty-handed. {name} claims someone inside has been winning for three nights without stopping.

reports.headline: Bells Under the Old Storehouse
reports.body: {name} swears the floor of the abandoned storehouse {dir} of here {dist} shakes after midnight to the sound of a crowd cheering and bells ringing a jackpot. By day it is empty, with a trapdoor nobody will open.
